outcome: Maternal toxicity (abortion, decreased mean body weight, weight gain, net body weight change, reduced food consumption)
Developmental toxicity (decreased fetal weight, external, visceral, and skeletal abnormalities of fetuses)
cohort: Pregnant New Zealand White Rabbits (25 artificially inseminated females per group) were administered methiozolin orally during gestation.
finding: High-dose methiozolin (500 mg/kg/day) induced maternal and developmental toxicities including abortion and decreased fetal weight, while lower doses (125 and 250 mg/kg/day) showed no signs of maternal or developmental toxicity.
